launches.tagline: Discover and play games, 3D worlds, interactive stories, generative art, and more.
launches.body:
Discover and play games, 3D worlds, interactive stories, generative art, and more\
\
<https://youtu.be/Zsb5yzZFmOo>

Hey, we’re Agam and Samagra

Three months ago, we launched Whip as a mobile feed where every post was an interactive AI creation. Anyone could describe an idea, turn it into a mini app, and publish it from their phone.

While building it, we realized the problem was much larger.

The internet is already full of remarkable interactive work: games, simulations, visual explanations, data stories, music toys, and 3D worlds. But it is scattered across personal websites and temporary links.

We usually discover these experiences through screen recordings on X, watch someone else use them, and lose them when the timeline moves on. There is no simple place to discover this work, follow its creators, or find what they make next.

So today, we’re launching Whip Web.

It is a YouTube-style feed where every post is an interactive experience. You can play directly in your browser, search by creator or interest, explore creator channels, and like, comment, or see play counts.

For creators, Whip turns a link into a channel and an audience. For everyone else, it makes the interactive internet easier to explore.

How you can help

Try a few experiences and tell us what we should improve or add next.\
\
<https://whip.run/?utm_source=bookface&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=web-whip&utm_content=launch>

launches.title: Whip - Social feed of interactive AI apps and games
launches.tagline: Scroll, play, remix, and publish interactive creations from your phone.
launches.body:
## TL;DR

Whip is a social feed where every post is an interactive AI creation you can actually play with. \
\
Instead of just posting a photo or video, you can post a tiny app: a game, a quiz, or something completely random. You can play with what others make, remix it, or describe your own idea and publish it to the feed.\
\
<https://youtu.be/jIwNViSc-B4>

## **Hey, we're Samagra and Agam**

We met in high school and have been building and hacking together for the last 4 years. \
\
We built Whip because over the past few years, we noticed a growing community of people using AI to vibe-code things purely for self-expression and entertainment.\
\
But most existing vibe-coding tools are like individual workspaces. You make something, share a link, and then it disappears into a group chat, a tweet, or a folder. There is no real place for these creations to live, spread, get remixed, and build a community around them.\
\
So we built Whip. Its a mobile app where the feed itself is made of interactive AI creations. Every post is something you can tap, swipe, or play with. A trivia game for your friends. A countdown for your event. A tiny game someone made in 2 minutes because it was funny.\
\
And if you like something, you can remix it into you own version and publish it back to the feed. Creating something new is just as simple. Describe what you want and whip builds it on your phone. \
\
We want Whip to become the social home for people who make with AI. Not just serious tools or productivity apps, but playful, weird, useful, disposable, personal things too.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101722&key=user_uploads/396588/53d04b8b-a89f-466f-8128-6ef25128455f)


## How you can help

Download Whip and make your first app. Scroll the feed, try a few creations, remix one you like, or describe your own idea and publish it.\
\
Download Whip:  <https://whip.onelink.me/iNbJ/92po4rio>

launches.title: 🚀 Tensorfuse - Deploy and scale LLM pipelines on your own cloud
launches.tagline: Tensorfuse makes it easy to deploy and manage LLM pipelines on your own cloud
launches.body:
### **Tl;dr**

[Tensorfuse](https://tensorfuse.io/) makes it easy to deploy and manage LLM pipelines on your own cloud. Simply connect your cloud to Tensorfuse, select your model, point to your data and click deploy. Tensorfuse will provision and manage the underlying infrastructure for you. Behind the scenes, we manage K8s + Ray clusters, enabling you to scale without LLMOps overhead.

### **About us**

We are [Agam](https://linkedin.com/in/agam-jn) and [Samagra](https://linkedin.com/in/samagra-sharma-4476bb135). We have experience deploying production machine learning systems at scale at Adobe and Qualcomm. You can see some of our work while using Adobe Scan. Additionally, Samagra authored the Java implementation of "AI: A Modern Approach," which is a widely used AI textbook in over 1,500 universities worldwide. Agam worked as a Computer Vision researcher at Qualcomm, where he published a paper and obtained a patent for image upscaling.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78531&key=user_uploads/396588/ca4c5c9f-32d4-4e65-92f3-5d12a3fcfce5)

### **Problem**

Companies in regulated spaces are constrained to build LLM apps on their cloud to maintain control over their data. However, managing and Scaling LLM infra is hard and it requires LLMOps expertise. Companies face the following issues: 

❌ Deployment complexities increase development time and operational overhead

❌ Auto-scaling requires sophisticated solutions and there are not enough LLMOps experts in the market 

### ✅ **Solution**

Tensorfuse provides a single API to manage your infra. Simply connect your cloud to Tensorfuse, select your model, point to your data and click deploy. Tensorfuse will provision and manage the underlying infrastructure for you. \
\
One of our clients managed to deploy a production-ready retriever in just 6 days, a process that would have otherwise required months of experimentation.

### ❇️ **Ask**

1. If you are facing issues in deploying LLM apps on your infra, contact us at [founders@tensorfuse.io](mailto:founders@tensorfuse.io) 
2. Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/tensorfuse) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/tensorfuse) for more updates.

launches.title: Ultra: Advisor for Ambitious Students
launches.body:
Hey everyone!\
\
**TL;DR:** Ultra helps ambitious students achieve anything; we’re launching our college admissions advisor, which focuses on helping students become extraordinary, which is more important than the application itself. \
\
**Ask:** We’d love to meet with two main categories: employers and educators (college counselors, principals, and school district leaders). We’ve already matched some very hungry and capable top 1% high school students to VC firms and YC startups as interns; we’d love to partner with more companies who are interested in building a talent pipeline here or otherwise interested in working with high schoolers. Contact us at [oliver@tryultra.org](mailto:oliver@tryultra.org) \
\
<https://youtu.be/9u-J96n09eU> \
\
**❌ The Problem**

Ambitious students are underserved. A hungry high schooler is capable of so much more than APs and creating fake non-profits to get into a college.\
\
But the guidance is often nothing or directly negative. Schools and counseling departments are already overwhelmed, so they have to focus their advice on the low-performing students. What is possible for a high schooler has also changed so much that a lot of previously sound advice has aged out. \
\
College remains the primary goal for ambitious high schoolers. And the best way to get in is to be shockingly impressive, which also helps later in life, too. But access to guidance on how to make yourself stand out to colleges is expensive (private college consultants) or not well packaged.\
\
[**👷**](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker) **Our Solution**\
We’ve created an AI advisor that helps students become extraordinary.

1. Firstly, we simulate the process that elite colleges use to evaluate profiles to give students an idea of what their odds are (Naviance but better).
2. Secondly, we give recommendations that students can iterate on. This pulls from a database of 3000+ opportunities, including opportunities exclusive to our platform, like high school-specific internships with venture-backed startups.
3. Finally, we have a 24/7 AI coach that calls users to check in with them and help them plan and reflect.

AI will make the top performers produce a larger and larger proportion of human work. We will help create this next generation of top performers from the most ambitious students of today.\
\
**🙏 Our Ask**\
\
We’d love to hear from you if you fall into these categories:

* Are you interested in working with or reaching the most ambitious high schoolers? We’ve got a range of partnership-led products coming up, working with startups and enterprises to help them recruit talent, get talent to use their products, and more. This could be as simple as posting opportunities to our platform and being able to recruit the best of the best at their scrappiest or creating job simulations.
* You’re in education and can help us reach school districts and counselors. We want to give our product for free to schools!
* If you’re a parent and can help us reach other parents with middle school to high school aged kids.
* And of course, if you found this as a high schooler: [useultra.ai](http://useultra.ai) is for you.

news.title: YC-backed CrowdVolt shakes up the secondary ticket market with its bid-ask model | TechCrunch

launches.title: ⚡️ CrowdVolt - StockX for live event tickets
launches.tagline: Exchange tickets to see your favorite DJs, electronic music shows and festivals!
launches.body:
**Tl;dr** [CrowdVolt](https://crowdvolt.com/) ⚡️ lets fans resell tickets to events, starting with raves & EDM concerts. We are a social, bid/ask style marketplace with counterparty security and favorable financing terms.

❌ **The problem**

The secondary ticketing marketplace is fundamentally broken. Fees have skyrocketed, while the user experience has deteriorated. As giants such as Ticketmaster and SeatGeek have moved towards lucrative primary sales in partnership with large venues, they have disenfranchised a whole class of live event attendees.

Many have naturally aggregated themselves on grey markets on legacy social media platforms (think Facebook marketplace and Reddit) to avoid institutional barriers and attempt to find better pricing/execution. These social platforms are not designed to house this type of exchange.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/aaead000-ef6c-4e10-ac85-0cc03a7a3b9c)

🔥  **Our solution – the StockX of tickets** (StockX uses a bid/ask style model for collectible sneakers and streetwear)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/8ae6c463-3456-4f1c-83c5-4c63c4626f4d)

* A two-sided marketplace for tickets: buyers can opt to “buy now” or bid, while sellers can opt to “sell now” or ask for a higher price, all with a publicly viewable transaction book
* Counterparty security: CrowdVolt intermediates transactions with secure payment processing, avoiding fraudulent activity and scams; third-party issued tickets are automatically transferred between counterparties
* Social: gone are the days of buying or selling from an anonymous blue dot on Ticketmaster; concerts are communal events meant to be experienced with others, so we’ve made buying and selling a social experience with social media integration and messaging
* Financing: sellers do not wait until event occurrence to receive payouts, but rather receive payment within days, alleviating the cash flow burden

Check out our promo [here](https://youtu.be/WszI6Jfi650)!

**🌃 Background**

[Josh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/josh-karol-4b1a97143/) and [Max](https://linkedin.com/in/max-hammer-2360571b2) grew up down the street from each other, while [Aria](https://linkedin.com/in/ariamohseni) and Josh met in college. We have diverse professional backgrounds across tech, finance, and consulting, but a common love for EDM (Aria is also a DJ, having played at iconic New York venues including the Williamsburg Hotel and Virgo Night Club in front of crowds numbering 2k+). We are avid attendees of this genre of events (80+ in 2023), and know the secondary marketplace experience through the existing mediums is poor, so have opted to rebuild it ourselves.

_A few years ago…_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/adf1e869-6351-48ec-b912-d88b7b01efa3)

_Now!_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78886&key=user_uploads/1410116/a49dd802-e56f-44fa-8d9c-64d0af809737)

**Our ask 🙏**

We’ve started in our hometown, New York, with our favorite genre of music, and will look to expand to other geographies and primary point of sale in the future.

* If you know anyone working in the live events space – ranging from artists to event managers to promoters – let us know! We’d love to connect.
* If you’re a fan of dance music, festivals, or raves (or have friends who are!) – hit us up at [founders@crowdvolt.com](mailto:founders@crowdvolt.com)!
* Sign up now at [https://www.crowdvolt.com](https://www.crowdvolt.com/) if you’re in New York, or join the waitlist for your city at <https://www.crowdvolt.com/waitlist>!

name: Text.ai
long_description:
We're building the first group chat with social skills.

While everyone else is stuck with boring individual chatbots, we've cracked the impossible: Alfi reads the room, understands each person, and creates custom intelligence for every group chat.

Alfi is your new social friend. The one who remembers everything, plans effortlessly, and keeps the crew together.

Here's what that looks like:

- Book restaurants together, with Yelp built in, directly in the chat. No more "where should we go?" spirals. Reserve instantly.
- Create images with your friends: drop your crew into funny hats, wild scenes, anything you can dream up. Multiplayer image gen, first of its kind.
- Social calendar: upcoming hangs, all in one place. Everyone on the same page.
- Group Wrapped: who's the chattiest? Top inside jokes? Now you'll know.
- Reminders & Memory: Alfi remembers your spots, your preferences, and nudges you to actually hang out.

We're in the middle of a quiet shift. Gen Z is leaving broadcast social media. They're retreating to group chats, smaller, more intentional and personal spaces where they're honestly themselves.

But group chats are also where plans go to die. Someone has to be "the planner" or nothing happens.

We believe the group chat is the real social network. Where the funniest moments and real conversations happen in real time. With Alfi, we hope to bring you together more expressively, a lot more often.

This technology will bring humanity closer than it's ever been before. Not replace connection, deepen it. That's the future we're building toward.

launches.title: Alfi: Your group chat with social skills
launches.tagline: The first chat app with social skills, for bringing friends together
launches.body:
Hey all 👋

**TL;DR:** We took everything we learned from 10M+ messages across 150+ countries and built something new: **Alfi, a chat app with social skills to bring friends together.**

Alfi is now live on [**iOS**](https://apps.apple.com/app/textai/6752585798) and [**Android**](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.text.app). Available in 10+ languages.

1. **Download [Alfi](https://www.text.ai/)**
2. **Add your people**: your other half, closest friends, your coworkers, or your annoying siblings
3. **Schedule your next hangout**: dinner, movie night, weekend trip. Let Alfi help.

**We believe the group chat is the real social network.**

If you've got a group chat that's been a little too quiet lately... this is your sign.

<https://youtu.be/pn07_bo6rfs>

**🔄 The Rapid Evolution**

You may remember [**text.ai**](http://text.ai), our AI that lives inside SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, and Telegram chats. Tens of thousands of users and over 10M+ messages across 150+ countries in a rapid few months showed us something we didn't expect:

People didn't just want answers. We realized they wanted a social friend who understands and acts. Together.

Not a sterile bot. Someone with personality and character. Someone who understood their unique group, who's vegan, who hates horror movies, who always wants ramen.

They wanted a premium chat experience that was inherently social.

Why?

We distilled it down to one thing.

There is a place where we feel our happiest. All of us.

The group.

Humans are born into them. And thrive in them. But today, there are very few products to support them.

Places where groups can live. But not thrive.

And so, friends drift apart. Plans go unplanned. The chat fades.

So, we started building Alfi, our human-first, AI native approach to messaging.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97165&key=user_uploads/310607/5d5804e8-4d4d-462d-b9b0-ee26332baaa4)

\
**💙 Meet Alfi**

Alfi is your new social friend. The one who remembers everything, plans effortlessly, and keeps the crew together. Alfi also has a proprietary framework that knows when to talk (and when not to). We taught Alfi… social skills! No commands required.

It doesn’t simply process but understands context, group dynamics, and whether you’re actually asking for help or just chatting with friends.

Here's what that looks like:

* **Book restaurants together**, with Yelp built in(exclusive partnership), directly in the chat. No more "where should we go?" spirals. Reserve instantly.
* **Create images _with_ your friends**: drop your crew into funny hats, wild scenes, anything you can dream up. Multiplayer image gen, first of its kind.
* **Social calendar**: upcoming hangs, all in one place. Everyone is on the same page. No more managing separate cals.
* **Group Wrapped**: who's the chattiest? Top inside jokes? Now you'll know. Something we all have wanted for the longest time!
* **Reminders & Memory**: Alfi remembers your spots, your preferences, and nudges you to actually stay connected.
* **Customize your Alfi**: Customize how Alfi responds, creates, and helps to fit in with your group’s style. Custom AI for each chat.

Of course, you have your solo Alfi too! The group chat is simply sacred.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97165&key=user_uploads/310607/126e5f00-0d43-4168-8675-072d98c8df63)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97165&key=user_uploads/310607/60ea2956-bc47-4b79-9dfb-77b8cae6a9e2)

Some beta user testimonies:

* "_It reminds my bf when he forgets our Farmers Market dates. Finally, someone else keeping him in check_ 😏"
* _"We put ourselves in cute dresses together. So cute. I wanna buy now"_

\
**🌍 Why This Matters**

We're in the middle of a quiet shift. Gen Z is leaving broadcast social media. They're retreating to group chats, smaller, more intentional and personal spaces where they're honestly themselves.

But group chats are also where plans go to die. Someone has to be "the planner" or nothing happens.

**We believe the group chat is the real social network.** Where the funniest moments and real conversations happen in real time. With Alfi, we hope to bring you together more expressively, a lot more often.

This technology will bring humanity closer than it's ever been before. Not replace connection, deepen it. That's the future we're building toward.

\
**👥 The Team On The Mission**

Founded by myself ( [@rushishah](https://www.producthunt.com/@rushishah) , ex-Tesla Youngest Product Lead), [@praharpatel](https://www.producthunt.com/@praharpatel) (Ex-Opentable, Eventbrite, Walmart Labs Engineering Lead ), and [@maniar](https://www.producthunt.com/@maniar) (Former Founder, ex-Gannett Media, McKinsey).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97165&key=user_uploads/310607/653a113c-abcb-4199-9887-027bbae6b3eb)

We're three friends who've been building consumer products together since college. Known each other for years. We're building Alfi because we've experienced firsthand how technology meant to connect people often creates more friction.

We’re taking a first principles approach. Something I learned firsthand from Elon during my time at Tesla. We believe AI should fit into your life, not the other way around.

---

\
**🙏 Our Ask:**

---

Please try out Alfi and share your feedback.

We’re on an ambitious mission to build the future of consumer messaging, and your feedback means a lot.

Can’t wait to show you what 2026 has in store. We have some insane product updates coming soon.

With gratitude (and excitement),

Rushi, Prahar, & Paras

👋 Hey everyone,

I'm Rushi, CEO & co-founder of [text.ai](http://text.ai). We're thrilled to share what we've been building, **AI that lives where you already chat, no downloads needed**.

**TL;DR**

# **💡 What is **[**text.ai**](https://text.ai)**?**

We've brought AI directly into SMS (US & CA for now), WhatsApp (worldwide), and Telegram (worldwide) which over 5.5 billion people use daily.

No new apps to download, no learning curve, just text and go.

Watch our YouTube product video:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SFOBlc6extw>

We also just made the top 5 on [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/text-ai) this past week! 

# **✅ How to try it:**

1\. Save our contact card: \[[text.ai](http://text.ai)\]

2\. Text directly or add to your group chats

3\. That's it! Works on \[[SMS](https://www.text.ai/)\], \[[WhatsApp](https://wa.me/15626840069?text=What%20is%20the%20best%20Hawaiian%20city%20to%20visit%20for%20Spring%20Break%3F)\], | \[[Telegram](https://t.me/thetextai_bot)\]

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89968&key=user_uploads/310607/11b0f146-9cef-4d39-9e68-63318cc9299f)

# 

**🤔 Why did we build this?**

Ever tried explaining to your mom how to download and use a new AI app? Yeah... that's why we built [text.ai](http://text.ai).

I built the first version just for fun, a personal travel companion for when I was hunting for hidden veggie restaurants on my first solo trip to Spain & Portugal (I'm vegetarian) and had no internet. It was ridiculously simple but solved a real problem for me.

Then something unexpected happened. Friends started adding our AI to their group chats. They used it to plan Vegas trips, settle restaurant debates, and even as a digital wingman for date nights.

The magic? No one had to download a thing. AI just showed up where they already were. In their messages.

Now we're obsessed with one mission: making AI accessible to everyone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89968&key=user_uploads/310607/2bf7fa71-528a-4991-9028-ee07c428c527)

# 

**🚀 Real magic happens in groups**

"TextAI saved our Friday night! Eight people with different diets, and it found this amazing Thai fusion place everyone loved. Even suggested dishes for our vegetarian friend. Now it's our go-to for plans!" - Jackie

No more endless screenshots. No more one person having to take charge. And finally, a solution for that friend who says "I'm okay with anything" and then rejects every suggestion!

We help your group actually make decisions instead of just talking about them.

Or you can use it to roast them.

Either way it works well.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89968&key=user_uploads/310607/0441afac-10f3-4c9a-85de-e6d04f843e7c)

**👥 The team behind the magic**

Founded by myself ( [@rushishah](https://www.producthunt.com/@rushishah) , ex-Tesla), [@praharpatel](https://www.producthunt.com/@praharpatel) (Ex-Walmart Labs, Eventbrite, Opentable), and [@maniar](https://www.producthunt.com/@maniar) (ex-Gannett Media, McKinsey).

We're three friends who've been building products together since college. We're building [text.ai](http://text.ai) because we've experienced firsthand how technology that's meant to connect people often ends up creating more friction instead.

We believe AI should fit into your life, not the other way around.

# **🔮 What's next?**

We're working towards going from just answers to action.

Soon, from that same group chat, you'll be able to book a restaurant reservation directly without ever leaving the conversation, get group reminders, book each other's calendars, and even purchase items together.

# 

**🙏 We'd love to hear from you**:

* What is the first thing you’d ask [text.ai](http://text.ai)?
* What group chat would you add [text.ai](http://text.ai) to first?
* Which feature would make this indispensable for you?
* Who in your life would find this most helpful?

👉 Try it now: \[[WhatsApp](https://wa.me/15626840069?text=What%20is%20the%20best%20Hawaiian%20city%20to%20visit%20for%20Spring%20Break%3F)\] | \[[Telegram](https://t.me/thetextai_bot)\] | \[[SMS](https://www.text.ai/)(Only US & CA for now)\]

launches.title: Digipals - AI-native Group Chats that get you outside
launches.tagline: Where AI makes us more social
launches.body:
Social media has become more media and less social. When I open up Facebook and Instagram, I don’t see any of my friends on it anymore - it’s one third ads, one third content from strangers on the internet, and one third AI slop. My friends are no longer on social media - I either meet up with them IRL or catch up with them in group chats.

https://youtu.be/KW2tjLl6sxM 

What if your group chats could help get you a reservation... and help you split the bill? Now it can.

We're building an AI-native group chat app that helps you hang out with your friends more. Your AI agent (digipal) knows your location, calendar, relationship history, and photos. It talks with your friends' digipals to coordinate IRL hangouts automatically - suggesting times when everyone's free, finding nearby restaurants and coffee shops, making reservations with AI calls, splitting bills from receipts, and nudging you to share photo memories after hanging out. 

Right now, coordinating hangouts with friends takes too much effort. We're removing that friction so you can spend less time planning and more time actually having fun IRL.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7bae7c14-2266-4d71-82e2-f23716cf4f2a)

**Where We're Going - The First AI-Native Social Operating System**

Digipals work through AI widgets that pop up right in your group chat when you and your friends need them. Talking about dinner? The restaurant widget appears. Someone sends a receipt? The bill split widget shows up. You never have to leave the group chat to coordinate.

We're starting with widgets that make it easier to hang out IRL - restaurant reservations, movie/concert suggestions, flight/hotel bookings, bill splitting, and sports scores. Here's some sneak peeks:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/91296545-05f9-4057-b324-b600168547b9)

Then we're adding widgets that help you stay close to your friends and make new ones - relive memories from fun times together in the past, post memes/articles/reels your group would actually find funny, surface life updates worth celebrating, and connect with friends of friends.

Eventually, anyone can build AI widgets for Digipals. Your group chat becomes the social operating system, and the widgets are the apps that enhance human connection.

**Team**

[Peggy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/peggy-wang-ai/) cares deeply about human relationships. For over nine years, she's grabbed dinner monthly with the same friends at Madras Cafe in Sunnyvale - the restaurant their group chat is named after. She's a second time founder who worked on the Metaverse at Meta Reality Labs, where she believed that the future of social connection was in virtual worlds and games. Now, she's convinced the future is simpler - it's showing up IRL.

Mathew made a hit solo game called [deadshot.io](http://deadshot.io) which has over 2M+ monthly active users. He enjoys connecting with others through playing music and video games, and joined the team to help make the future a little less lonely for everyone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7ee11258-ded8-466d-a9e5-ac5819801ad0)

**Asks**

* Please join the waitlist at [www.digipals.app](http://www.digipals.app) - we’ll be launching soon 👀 If you know Peggy personally, you can DM/text her to get early access :)
